reels.title: Google for Startups Cloud Program: Up to $350,000 in Cloud & Gemini Credits

editorial_notes.reasoning: With the highest tier of funding ($350k) and a strong focus on the 'AI-first' ecosystem, this provides the most significant value to our founder-developer audience while allowing for a clear 'AI infrastructure vs. API intelligence' architectural visualization.
editorial_notes.recommended_hook: What if you could build the next Gemini-powered unicorn without ever paying for your own server costs?
editorial_notes.suggested_everyday_analogy: Treating infrastructure credits like a 'unlimited budget' VIP pass at a massive global construction site for code.
